name: Leifeng Pagoda
description: Leifeng Pagoda, also known as Huangfei Pagoda and Xiguan Brick Pagoda, is located on Leifeng Peak in Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province. It is a pagoda built by Qian Hongchu, King Zhongyi of Wuyue, because Huang Fei had a son. Leifeng Pagoda is an artistic masterpiece in the history of Chinese tower building. It is the first to have an octagonal plane, majestic scale, beautiful scenery, and has extremely high artistic value and historical and cultural value. It is also used as an important element in the popular folk tale "The Legend of the White Snake". The old Leifeng Pagoda collapsed in 1924, and the newly built Leifeng Pagoda is the first colorful bronze pagoda in China.
